name: Virna Jandiroba
event: UFC Fight Night: Bonfim vs. Brady
summary: A Brazilian jiu-jitsu specialist (23-4, age 38) and the most dangerous submission grappler at strawweight: 14 of her 23 wins are submissions. She lost a five-round decision to Mackenzie Dern for the vacant title in October 2025, then out-grappled Tabatha Ricci in April. She has never been stopped; all four losses were decisions.

how_they_fight.Striking: Serviceable, not a weapon: about 2.3 significant strikes landed a minute and absorbs more than she lands. Held her own on the feet with Ricci and kept landing in R2 (Cageside). Dern out-landed her 118-106 over five rounds and cut her with the jab in R2 (Uncrowned).
how_they_fight.Grappling: Cuts off the cage, closes, and takes the back or drags opponents down along the fence (Cageside on Ricci). Top game is heavy: half guard and arm-triangle attempts against Ricci, and an armbar off a back take against Amanda Lemos (R2, 4:48, 2024). She took Dern down nine times in 17 attempts, more than any of Dern's previous opponents (Uncrowned). Control: 8:00 against Ricci and about 10 minutes against Yan Xiaonan in our data.
how_they_fight.Defense: Never finished. Takedown defense of 62% in our data; Suarez is a different class of wrestler than anyone she has faced. Comfortable off her back, but she has spent little time there in recent fights.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Steady, good cardio; has gone 25 minutes twice (a 2018 split-decision win over Mizuki Inoue in Invicta, and the Dern loss), and submitted Lemos late in R2 of a scheduled five-rounder. Her finishes came early in her career (8 subs in R1, 5 in R2, 1 in R3; one R2 TKO), but in the UFC she has gone to decision in five of her last six. Stayed aggressive through R5 against Dern (Uncrowned). Not a late fader.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Experienced and patient; she trained with Demian Maia in a previous camp for insight on facing strong wrestlers and has done two camps for this fight (Sherdog).

patterns: Cut off the cage, clinch, take the back
Heavy top control and arm attacks (arm-triangle, armbar)
Recent fights go to decision; never stopped
Consistent pace across three or five rounds
concerns: Wrestling defense against an elite wrestler; she has mostly been the one shooting
Gets out-struck at range by better strikers (Dern)
keys_to_beat: Out-wrestle her or keep it standing and win the striking exchanges
Don't give up the back in scrambles
Keep top position tight: she threatens from guard

news.text: Said she has done two training camps for Suarez, and called the matchup a 'clash of titans'. She wants a third fight with champion Mackenzie Dern in early 2027.
Beat Tabatha Ricci by decision (30-27, 29-28, 29-28), with takedowns in every round.
